newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on institutional support.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher as major engineering, pharmaceutical, food and leather scrips gained mainly on support from the state-owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB), brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 26.94, or 2.36 percent, to 1,166.48 in turnover of 52.6 million taka on Sunday. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.
"We had small buying orders from retail investors. Only a few big players and the ICB were active, which lifted the market," said one broker.
Bangladesh Lamps gained 41 taka to 4,461, Apex food rose 38 to 2,062, and ACI was up 3.91 to 146.32.
